d: This is a unofficial translation by me as there is no official hindi version available I felt very uneased about it and decided to translate it by myself (Episode 52,130,132 & Episodes beyond 144 don't have official hindi version). I am also working on episode 130 & 132 to complete the hindi library up to episode 144. In future i might try to translate the remaining episodes. Hope you guys like my work and let me know if you have any suggestions. Thank you.
